description.value: Greendale Liquor Store is a retail liquor shop on Yale Road (off Highway 1 Exit 109) in Chilliwack, operated by the Liquor Giant Group with six Fraser Valley locations. The store carries spirits, wine, BC craft beer, and ready-to-drink products, and offers bulk ordering for events as well as third-party delivery. It is a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Greendale area who need to resupply on beverages.
